pge-3ce-sbco.providerHint: Most residents in the Santa Ynez Valley are served by 3CE for generation. PG&E handles delivery for all customers.

pge-sjce-scc.providerHint: Most residents in San José are served by San José Clean Energy for generation. PG&E handles delivery for all customers.

pge-pce-smc.name: PG&E + PCE (San Mateo County)
pge-pce-smc.providerHint: Most residents in San Mateo County are served by Peninsula Clean Energy for generation. PG&E handles delivery for all customers.

pge-scp-son.name: PG&E + SCP (Sonoma County)
pge-scp-son.providerHint: Most residents in Sonoma County are served by Sonoma Clean Power for generation. PG&E handles delivery for all customers.

pge-ava-eba.name: PG&E + Ava (East Bay)
pge-ava-eba.providerHint: Most residents in Oakland and the East Bay are served by Ava Community Energy for generation. Note: Ava rates include System Fees. PG&E handles delivery for all customers.

pge-svce-sv.name: PG&E + SVCE (Silicon Valley)
pge-svce-sv.providerHint: Most residents in Sunnyvale and nearby Silicon Valley cities are served by Silicon Valley Clean Energy for generation. PG&E handles delivery for all customers.

pge-mce-mar.providerHint: Most residents in Marin County are served by MCE Clean Energy for generation. PG&E handles delivery for all customers.

pge-rcea-hum.name: PG&E + RCEA (Humboldt County)
pge-rcea-hum.providerHint: Most residents in Humboldt County are served by Redwood Coast Energy Authority for generation. PG&E handles delivery for all customers.

pge-vce-yol.name: PG&E + VCE (Yolo County)
pge-vce-yol.providerHint: Most residents in Davis and Yolo County are served by Valley Clean Energy for generation. PG&E handles delivery for all customers.

pge-pioneer-pla.name: PG&E + Pioneer (Placer County)
pge-pioneer-pla.providerHint: Most residents in Roseville and Placer County are served by Pioneer Community Energy for generation. Pioneer uses flat blended rates. PG&E handles delivery for all customers.

pge-cpsf-sf.name: PG&E + CleanPowerSF (San Francisco)
pge-cpsf-sf.providerHint: Most residents in San Francisco are served by CleanPowerSF for generation. PG&E handles delivery for all customers.

pge-kccp-mon.name: PG&E + KCCP (Monterey County)
pge-kccp-mon.providerHint: Residents in King City area are served by King City Community Power. KCCP rates are only available for E-1 and E-TOU-C plans. PG&E handles delivery for all customers.
